$comment: +++===+++ 2026-10-22 — Hasan Alizada — HAAL-066. Recurrence of events (FR-CAL-10, F-20, owner decision D-60). Dates only: the wall-clock time of an occurrence is applied per date afterwards (time.local_to_utc.v1) and the viewer's days come from time.event_days.v1, so DST never shifts a series. Needed on the client (offline day/week/month views) and on the server (validation now; agenda, reminders, export later).
purpose: Lists the dates on which an event occurs inside a window of at most 367 days, and tells whether an RRULE is one this version supports.

start_date.description: First occurrence (the event's start date in its own zone).

rrule.description: null = one-off event. Supported in v1, exactly as written: FREQ=DAILY, FREQ=WEEKLY, FREQ=MONTHLY, FREQ=YEARLY (RFC 5545 RRULE value without the 'RRULE:' prefix).

exceptions.description: Occurrence dates removed from the series (recurrence exceptions); dates that are no occurrence are ignored.

to.description: Last date of the window (inclusive); to − from ≤ 366 days.

dates.description: Occurrence dates inside the window, ascending, without exceptions.

errors.when: rrule is not null and not one of the four supported values (case and spacing count)
to − from is more than 366 days

invariants: no date before start_date is ever returned
rrule = null → [start_date] when start_date is inside the window, else []
FREQ=DAILY → every date from start_date on
FREQ=WEEKLY → start_date + 7·k days (the weekday of start_date)
FREQ=MONTHLY → the day of month of start_date in every month that has it; months without it are skipped (RFC 5545), never moved to the last day
FREQ=YEARLY → the day and month of start_date every year; 29 February only in leap years
a series has no end in v1 (FR-CAL-10); every occurrence spans one day
the result depends on dates only — no time zone, no clock
